# Full freeze of the RUNTIME dependency set, for exact reproduction.
#
#   python -m pip install -r requirements.lock.txt
#
# CI deliberately installs from requirements.txt instead, so that a breaking
# upstream release shows up as a red build rather than silently going unnoticed.
# Use this file when you need the exact set that was verified, e.g. an air-gapped
# install or reproducing a reported bug.
#
# Generated by installing requirements.txt into a clean Python 3.13 environment
# and freezing the result. It covers the service only — test tooling (pytest,
# hypothesis, coverage, pluggy, iniconfig, Pygments, sortedcontainers) and the
# linter are in requirements-dev.txt and deliberately absent here.
#
# This file used to be generated from an environment that had the development
# requirements installed, so eight of its twenty-five entries were test tooling.
# An air-gapped production install would have put pytest and hypothesis on a
# machine that never imports them.
#
# Note: the `winrt-*` packages (bleak's Windows Bluetooth backend) are omitted
# because they are Windows-only and would fail to resolve on Linux. They are
# installed automatically with bleak on Windows.
bleak==1.1.1
blinker==1.9.0
click==8.5.0
colorama==0.4.6
et_xmlfile==2.0.0
Flask==3.1.3
itsdangerous==2.2.0
Jinja2==3.1.6
MarkupSafe==3.0.4
openpyxl==3.1.5
pycryptodome==3.23.0
qrcode==8.2
typing_extensions==4.16.0
waitress==3.0.2
Werkzeug==3.1.9
